prompt: Technical exploded-view product render of the PD42 holographic LED fan, its five parts floating apart in a straight line along one shared central axis, seen from a three-quarter front angle, slightly from above, the axis running from front-left to back-right with even gaps between the parts. The cover is the largest part and the LED bar spans nearly its full diameter. Seamless pure black studio background, soft overhead key light, thin cool rim light on every edge, crisp highlights on the acrylic, faint reflection on a dark glossy floor. Realistic premium catalogue render, all five parts fully in frame. No text, no labels, no numbers, no logo, no other objects.
